data.one_liner: A chat widget toolkit for Flutter with message grouping, async sending, and custom bubbles.
data.what_it_does: Provides a drop-in chat UI for Flutter applications. It handles message grouping, asynchronous sending with retry logic, message lists, and customizable bubble styles.
use_when: You need to build a chat interface quickly with ready-to-use bubble lists and input fields.
You want automatic message grouping and tie-breaker sorting for timestamps.
avoid_when: You require an end-to-end messaging backend client rather than just a UI toolkit.
strengths: Extensible message elements and customizable bubble configuration
Built-in async dispatch with retry mechanisms
weaknesses: Does not include backend integration out-of-the-box
